title: GMC employees' protest enters day 13, two women continue hunger strike

ai.summary: Female employees of Government Medical College Rajouri continued a 13-day hunger strike alongside sit-in protest, demanding service recruitment rules for non-gazetted cadre employees recruited seven years ago.

facts.claim: Female employees of Government Medical College Rajouri continued their hunger strike throughout Friday night
facts.quote: Female employees of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri continued their hunger strike throughout Friday night as the protest by non-gazetted cadre employees of five new government medical colleges in Jammu and Kashmir entered its 13th day on Saturday.
the protest by non-gazetted cadre employees of five new government medical colleges in Jammu and Kashmir entered its 13th day on Saturday.

facts.claim: Two staff members take turns to participate each day
facts.quote: At GMC Rajouri, employees are holding a sit-in protest alongside a chain hunger strike, with two staff members taking turns to participate each day.

facts.claim: The protest has affected healthcare services
facts.quote: The ongoing agitation has also affected healthcare services at the medical college.

The protesting employees are demanding the formulation of service recruitment rules, saying they were recruited in the new medical colleges around seven years ago but the rules governing their service conditions and career progression have yet to be framed.

ai.background_note: Female employees of Government Medical College Rajouri have been protesting for 13 days, demanding service recruitment rules for non-gazetted cadre employees who were recruited seven years ago but lack defined career progression rules.
